about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Excellence in Steel & Iron International Trade
about.p1: Sivas Iron Metal stands as a premier leader in the global steel and iron import/export industry. With decades of experience and unwavering commitment to quality, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner for businesses worldwide seeking premium metal products.
about.p2: Our company specializes in sourcing, processing, and distributing high-grade steel and iron materials to meet diverse industrial needs. We pride ourselves on maintaining the highest standards of quality control, ensuring that every product that leaves our facilities meets or exceeds international specifications.
about.p3: At Sivas Iron Metal, we understand that in today's global economy, reliable supply chains and consistent quality are paramount. That's why we've built strong relationships with suppliers and clients across continents, creating a robust network that enables seamless international trade.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To shape the future of international metal trade by continuously innovating, expanding our global reach, and setting new benchmarks for quality and service excellence in the industry.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To be the global leader in steel and iron trade by delivering exceptional quality products, maintaining the highest standards of customer service, and building lasting partnerships based on trust and reliability.

quality.title: Quality Policy
quality.content: In accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001 standards, we commit to keeping customer satisfaction at the highest level, continuously improving our processes, and fully complying with legal regulations.

history.title: Our History
history.content: Our journey, which started as a small workshop in Sivas in 1994, has turned into a giant industrial organization exporting to more than 20 countries today. We continue to grow by increasing our capacity every year.

quality.title: Quality First
quality.desc: Uncompromising commitment to delivering products that exceed expectations and meet the highest international standards.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.desc: Consistent performance and dependable service that our clients can count on, every single time.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.desc: Transparent business practices and ethical conduct in all our dealings with clients, partners, and stakeholders.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.desc: Continuous improvement and adoption of best practices to stay ahead in an evolving global marketplace.

customer.title: Customer Focus
customer.desc: Dedicated to understanding and meeting the unique needs of each client with personalized service and solutions.

global.title: Global Perspective
global.desc: Worldwide network and cultural understanding that enables successful international trade relationships.

products.title: Our Products
products.description: Comprehensive Range of Steel & Iron Products
products.intro: We offer a comprehensive range of high-quality steel and iron products for diverse industrial applications. From construction materials to specialized alloys, our products meet the highest international standards and specifications.

hr-sheets.name: Hot Rolled Sheets
hr-sheets.desc: High strength sheets used in general structural steels, pipe profile production, and machinery manufacturing.

cr-sheets.name: Cold Rolled Sheets
cr-sheets.desc: Precision surface sheets preferred in automotive, white goods, and radiator production.

galvanized-pipes.name: Galvanized Pipes
galvanized-pipes.desc: Long-lasting pipes with high corrosion resistance used in water and gas installations.

box-profiles.name: Box Profiles
box-profiles.desc: Square and rectangular profiles used in steel construction structures, roof systems, and machine chassis.

ipe-profiles.name: IPE Profiles
ipe-profiles.desc: I-section profiles used in the load-bearing systems of industrial structures and multi-story buildings.

steel-mesh.name: Steel Mesh
steel-mesh.desc: Reinforcement material used in reinforced concrete structures, field concretes, and tunnel formwork systems.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Get in Touch With Our Team
contact.intro: For product inquiries, quotes, orders, or any questions about our steel and iron products, please contact us directly. We prioritize phone communication for immediate assistance and personalized service.
contact.infoDesc: You can reach us via the contact channels below or leave a message by filling out the form.

general.title: General Information
general.content: Sivas Iron Metal aims to add value to its investors with its transparent and accountable management approach. Our company continues to be a trusted harbor in the sector with its sustainable growth strategies and strong financial structure.

financial.title: Financial Data
financial.content: Our financial statements, income statements, and balance sheets for the last 5 years are regularly audited and shared with the public. Our profitability ratios and growth figures are in a stable upward trend.

stock.title: Stock Information
stock.content: You can access detailed information about our company's stock performance, dividend policies, and capital increase processes here. Protecting the rights of our investors is our top priority.

reports.title: Annual Reports
reports.content: Our annual and quarterly activity reports, board of directors messages, and future vision are located in this section.

policy.title: Environmental Policy
policy.content: We commit to minimizing environmental impacts in our production processes to leave a livable world for future generations. We lead the sector with our energy efficiency, waste management, and carbon footprint reduction efforts.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.content: We document our sensitivity to the environment with our ISO 14001 Environmental Management System and other international sustainability certificates.

social.content: We continue to add value to society with our social responsibility projects in the fields of education, health, and environment.

policy.content: We attach importance to the personal and professional development of our employees and offer a fair and transparent working environment. Our human resources are our greatest strength.

production.title: Production Capability
production.subtitle: State-of-the-Art Manufacturing
production.intro: Our production facilities are equipped with the latest technology to ensure high precision and quality in every product. We maintain strict quality control standards throughout the manufacturing process.

1.title: Raw Material Selection
1.desc: Sourcing the finest quality raw materials from certified suppliers.

2.title: Precision Processing
2.desc: Using advanced machinery for cutting, shaping, and forming.

3.title: Quality Testing
3.desc: Rigorous testing for strength, durability, and compliance.

4.title: Final Finishing
4.desc: Surface treatment and coating for enhanced longevity.

capacity.title: Production Capacity
capacity.desc: With a monthly capacity of over 50,000 tons, we are ready to meet large-scale industrial demands.

technology.title: Technology & Innovation
technology.desc: We continuously invest in R&D and modern machinery to stay ahead in the steel industry.
